description: Remove vekd CLI from the implementation plan and update all documentation to reflect that vekd is exclusively a web UI/dashboard binary with no CLI interface beyond the initial install command.
steps: In docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md, completely remove section '4.7 vekd CLI' (the entire subsection including the list of CLI commands like vekd init, vekd status, vekd apps *, vekd users *, vekd cloudflare *, vekd backup, vekd restore).

Update the Phase 4 title/description in docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md to emphasize that vekd is a web UI-only binary. Change the goal statement to clarify that all management is done via the web dashboard at :8080 after a one-time install.

Update section 4.5 (Web UI) in docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md to explicitly state it is the ONLY user interface for vekd - all operations that were listed in the removed CLI section should be achievable through the web UI.

Update the Phase 4 Success Criteria in docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md to remove any mention of CLI commands and replace with web UI equivalents. For example, change 'Apps deploy from git repos with one click or CLI command' to 'Apps deploy from git repos via the web dashboard'.

Update docs/ARCHITECTURE.md in the 'Deployment Architecture' section - remove any references to vekd having a CLI. The deployment flow description should reference only the web UI for management after initial install.
Renumber the Phase 4 sections if needed after removing 4.7 (sections should be 4.1 through 4.6 with no gaps).
acceptance_criteria: docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md has no section 4.7 and no vekd CLI commands listed anywhere
Phase 4 description and success criteria reference only web UI for management operations
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md does not reference vekd CLI commands
The deployment workflow is clear: SSH once to install, then everything is managed via web UI at :8080
Section numbering in Phase 4 is clean (4.1 through 4.6, no gaps)
verification: Run 'grep -rn "vekd init\|vekd status\|vekd apps\|vekd users\|vekd cloudflare\|vekd backup\|vekd restore\|4.7 vekd CLI" docs/' and confirm no matches
Run 'make -C /projects/sandbox/vek' to ensure no build issues (docs change should not affect build)
